svg.title: Thirty days to an instrumented operating pilot
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-controlled-launch; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days to an instrumented operating pilot; subtitle: Four milestones prepare the exchange; first-deal planning remains one to three months.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values mark milestone end days. This sprint establishes buyer terms, tested routing, capped experiments, and reconciliation. It does not assume a buyer payment or profitable campaign will arrive within the first 30 days.; caption: Increase exposure only after the evidence, contribution, and collection record supports it. Carry unfinished buyer contracting or collection work into the stated one-to-three-month deal window.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define one niche and executable buyer terms; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one jurisdiction and service category. Document call price, connected-time definition, duplicate window, rejection reasons, payment timing, and recording duties. Complete the four pre-flight checks and assign a named owner to each operating control.; label: Days 8-14; value: Prove routing and evidence with authorized test calls; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure Ringba or Retreaver buyer caps and fallback paths. Test no-bid, timeout, disconnect, duplicate-event, and webhook-retry cases. Verify evidence retrieval and recording access without sending test conversions into production bid optimization.; label: Days 15-21; value: Run capped cohorts and inspect every disputed call; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Release a limited acquisition tranche after buyer contracting is complete. Compare source cost, connected duration, buyer acceptance, and evidence completeness. Reconcile S2S values to accepted calls; pause faulty routes rather than padding call duration.; label: Days 22-30; value: Close the first reconciliation and set the next exposure cap; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Match call records, buyer statements, publisher invoices, and any received payments. Separate billed amounts from cash collected. If net-7 collectability remains unproven, retain pilot caps and extend observation instead of treating an unpaid invoice as validated demand.
